name: io.github.Guard-Core/guard-core-mcp
description: MCP server that answers Guard-ecosystem security questions from the libraries actually installed in your interpreter: SecurityConfig validation against the installed pydantic models (catches unknown keys pydantic silently drops), config-field lookup, docs search over the vendored and hand-written corpora, live threat detection through guard-core's real engine, and verified setup guidance for FastAPI, Flask, Django, Express, Fastify, NestJS, Hono, Gin, Fiber, Echo, Laravel, Symfony and more.
